result.brief: 提出软体物体世界模型，基于点云历史上下文推断形状与材质潜变量并做动作条件动力学预测，结合目标条件规划器实现双臂衣物折叠。
result.reason: Learns a soft-object world model with in-context latent property inference and action-conditioned dynamics for bimanual garment manipulation; main contribution is robot manipulation world modeling, not video representation.
